scenario: WF-3 ([LNUL.4.3]) — `s.state > 85` does NOT fire on a null reading (comparison propagates null; null does not fire — the safety property). fact_count 1 (Sensor only, no Marker).
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float? mutable

schema Marker scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Sensor s where s.state > 85.0
->
    emit Marker logical entity_id: s.entity_id
